bio: This pleasant and elegant restaurant has been run by the same family since 1928 and is now in the hands of the fifth generation! A historical monument frozen in time? Far from it – the chef puts a brilliant contemporary spin on the riches of the terroir. The pretty space is simple, cosy and utterly charming; however, in fine weather, head for the large covered terrace overlooking the flower-decked garden. A welcoming establishment where they take pride in what they do....
